channel.title: Devin Desaulniers' Greater Vancouver Real Estate Blog
channel.description: Greater Vancouver and Tri-Cities, BC real estate news, explained in plain language by Devin Desaulniers, Real Estate Associate with Axford Real Estate.

item.title: Canada's best cities for work in 2026: Vancouver is 4th for pay, last for rent
item.dc:creator: Devin Desaulniers
item.description: I built a Canadian version of the viral \"Best Cities for Work\" map, ranking our 23 biggest metros on public StatCan and CMHC data. Vancouver lands 11th: top 5 for pay, dead last for pay vs. rent.

item.title: Metro Vancouver's September home sales: a condo slowdown, not a market-wide one
item.dc:creator: Devin Desaulniers
item.description: Greater Vancouver REALTORS® says September sales fell 8.4% from last year, but the drop was almost all apartments. Here's my plain-language read and what it means if you're buying, selling or renting.
